---
title: "Topics"
subtitle: "The vocabulary behind the catalog filters."
description: "The canonical topics of the Resources Catalog, with live entry counts, plus type and language facets."
search: true
---

Every `category` value in the catalog is one of the canonical topics listed in [`scripts/tags.toml`](https://github.com/antoinelucasfra/resources-catalog/blob/main/scripts/tags.toml) — there are no per-entry invented tags. `scripts/lint.py` rejects anything outside that list, so this page and the topic filter on the [home page](index.qmd) are built from the same values and always report the same counts.

Counts below are computed live from `resources.txt` at render time. An entry carries exactly one type, so type counts sum to the catalog size; topics and languages are multi-valued, so their counts sum to more than the number of entries.

```{r topics}
#| execute: true
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
source(here::here("resources.R"))

resources <- parse_resources_md(here::here("resources.txt"))

esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}

topic_values <- unlist(lapply(resources$category, split_values))
type_values <- resources$type[nzchar(resources$type)]
lang_values <- unlist(lapply(resources$language, split_values))

topic_counts <- table(topic_values)
type_counts <- table(type_values)
lang_counts <- table(lang_values)

badges <- function(counts) {
  counts <- sort(counts, decreasing = TRUE)
  cat(
    paste0(
      '<span class="badge text-bg-secondary mx-1 my-1" style="font-size: 0.95rem;">',
      esc(names(counts)), " &middot; ", counts, "</span>"
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}

cat(sprintf(
  '<p class="text-muted">%d topics, %d types, and %d language values across %d entries.</p>\n\n',
  length(topic_counts), length(type_counts), length(lang_counts), nrow(resources)
))

cat("## Topics\n\n")
badges(topic_counts)

cat("\n\n## Types\n\n")
cat(
  '<p class="text-muted small">A closed list of resource kinds. Books, packages, and repositories keep their kind regardless of where they are hosted.</p>\n\n'
)
badges(type_counts)

cat("\n\n## Languages\n\n")
cat(
  '<p class="text-muted small"><strong>Other</strong> marks entries that are not tied to a particular programming language (most websites, books, and papers). <strong>French</strong> marks French-language content and can appear alongside a programming language.</p>\n\n'
)
badges(lang_counts)
```
